candidates.change_summary: Replace totalSupply decrement with a no-op (e.g., a dummy variable assignment) so totalSupply is not decreased.
Delete the statement `totalSupply -= _value;` so totalSupply remains unchanged.
Replace totalSupply decrement with totalSupply increment, so totalSupply increases instead of decreases.
Remove balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; so the sender's balance does not decrease on burn
Remove totalSupply -= _value; so totalSupply does not decrease on burn
Change balanceOf subtraction from msg.sender to a different address (e.g., address(1))
Change the require to require(balanceOf[msg.sender] > _value) so burn fails when balance equals _value
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from burn so any account can call it
